notes:
The names were still cut and this is why: the tool only preferred protel's name when the in-house list's date matched the report's night — and you audit the night that has just ended while the in-house list always says today. After midnight they never matched. It compares the NAMES now: if the printed one is the opening of protel's, the whole name wins.

Also: the room database is kept in RecCheck's own folder as well, scrambled so it cannot be read by opening it, and with legacy mode OFF the tool reads protel's in-house list by itself every five seconds, on any screen, for as long as it is running. Legacy mode stays the default and stays manual.
